name: Jabari Panther

abilityDetails.Cleanse: Bu etkiye sahip şampiyon bir debuff aldığında, debuff anında arındırılır ve Cleanse kaldırılır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Ensnare: Kaçış (Evade) etkinleşmesini engeller ve yetenek doğruluğunu azaltır.
abilityDetails.Counterpunch: Bir saldırıyı bloklarken şarj harcayarak kısa süreli Unstoppable kazanır ve anında karşı saldırı yapılabilir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Sanar bonusu kazanır ve sürekli purify eder. 10 avcı yükünde destreza'yı kapatır ve sersemlemeye immün olur. Prowess'li şampiyon (avcı yüklerini siler) veya White Magneto ön-dövüşü kullan.
signatureAbility:
Chosen of Ghekre
The duration of the Hunt is increased by [0.5 - 3] second(s).
Whenever Jabari Panther would gain a Huntress Charge while the Hunt is active, she instead gains an indefinite Counterpunch Charge. Max Charges starts at 1, and increases by 1 for every 50 signature levels obtained.
A Counterpunch Charge is spent to gain Unstoppable for 0.75 second(s) when Blocking an Attack, and all are lost when the Hunt ends.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Gain a non-stacking Cleanse Passive for 2 second(s).
While fighting as a Defender, if Jabari Panther Purifies a Stun Debuff, this ability goes on cooldown for 8 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits
content: Inflict a Bleed Debuff, dealing [6,863.35] Direct Damage over 7 second(s).
If this Bleed fails due to Immunity against a Science Champion, gain a +[603.66] Cruelty Passive for 7 seconds.

abilitySections.title: The Huntress
content: A skilled huntress, Jabari Panther stalks her Opponents no matter where they run or hide. Gain 1 Huntress Charge when Intercepting an Opponent, or Attacking a Stunned or Ensnared Opponent. This ability can only trigger every 1.25 seconds.
Gain 2 Huntress Charges whenever Jabari Panther Purifies a Debuff, and when the Opponent Evades or causes an Attack to Miss. This ability can only trigger every 1.25 seconds.
After gaining any Charges, no more can be gained for 1.25 second(s).
Lose 2 Huntress Charge(s) whenever the Opponent gains a Prowess Buff or Passive.

abilitySections.title: The Hunt
content: When Jabari Panther reaches 20 Huntress Charges, remove them all and Hunt the Opponent for 9 second(s).

Once Jabari Panther has 10+ Huntress Charge, the next time she activates a Special Attack or the Opponent would Evade or cause and attack to Miss, remove them all and Hunt the Opponent for 9 second(s).
While the Hunt is on, Jabari Panther is Stun Immune and gains a Precision Buff, increasing Critical Rating by +[916.67].
Additionally, the Opponent cannot trigger the Dexterity mastery, Evade, or cause Attacks to Miss.
Whenever Jabari Panther Purifies a Debuff, or the Opponent fails a Miss or Evade, Pause the Hunt and all Fury Buffs on Jabari Panther for 2 second(s).
Inflicting a Bleed Debuff Pauses all Bleed Debuffs on the Opponent for 0.5 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: If the Hunt is active, each Bleed Debuff on the Opponent has a 50% chance to inflict another Bleed Debuff, dealing [6863.35] Direct Damage over 7 second(s). This ends the Hunt.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Activating any Special Attack and the Hunt within 1 second(s) of each other grants a non-stacking Fury Buff, increasing Attack Rating by +[16,894.4] for 9 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict an Ensnare Debuff on the Opponent for 11 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The Hunt is Paused during this Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: The next time the Hunt activates, the Opponent is also Stunned for 4.5 second(s).
Gain 3 permanent Huntress charge(s) that are not removed when the Hunt triggers. Max 6.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Chosen of Ghekre

Whenever Jabari Panther would gain a Huntress Charge while the Hunt is active, she instead gains an indefinite Counterpunch Charge. Max Charges starts at 1, and increases by 1 for every 50 signature levels obtained.
A Counterpunch Charge is spent to gain Unstoppable for 0.75 second(s) when Blocking an Attack, and all are lost when the Hunt ends.
